text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"To begin with my talent\" ... \"Next my skill\" ... \"Finally both of my skill and talent\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured with distinct sections that guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"\"I am identifying a talent or skill I have, and explaining how i develop and use it\"","quality":"task focus","description":"The essay stays more directly centered on the prompt by framing and revisiting the assigned topic throughout."},{"evidence":"\"my talent is roaring like a lion\" ... \"My other talent is hoola-hooping with my arms\" ... \"My final talent is drawing\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay gives more specific examples and elaboration for its claims instead of repeating general statements."},{"evidence":"\"I use my arms and legs for more movement\" ... \"I would beat my friend's scores\"","quality":"sentence elaboration","description":"The essay more often expands ideas with supporting detail rather than leaving them in short, loosely connected remarks."},{"evidence":"\"I am identifying\" ... \"I believe\" ... \"embrace it and share it to the world\"","quality":"language control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of standard English phrasing and reads more coherently overall despite errors."}]}
